depot_status: Completed (All 10 backup sample tubes safely deposited on the surface between Dec 2022 and Jan 2023)
purpose: First off-world sample cache depot established as an insurance policy for the NASA-ESA Mars Sample Return (MSR) campaign; retrieval by Sample Recovery Helicopters or astronauts

tubes.scientific_value: Coarse-grained olivine-rich igneous rock formed inside an ancient magma chamber or thick lava lake; provides absolute radioisotope age date for Jezero floor cratering history.
Fine-grained sulfate and clay mudstone laid down in quiet lake waters; prime target for preserving microscopic bio-textures and ancient cellular structures.
Pure Martian ambient atmospheric gas sealed at 7.2 mbar; tracks atmospheric argon, xenon, krypton isotope ratios to measure planetary air loss over 4 billion years.
Coarser fluvial delta deposits carried down the Neretva Vallis river system from highlands far outside Jezero Crater, representing regional crustal sampling.
Unconsolidated windblown dust, fine gravel, and microscopic impact spherules; crucial for studying modern surface radiation, dust abrasive properties, and perchlorate chemistry.
Upper crater floor volcanic rock with secondary mineral alteration along micro-fractures; records the moment volcanic lavas flooded Jezero Crater.
Richest organic carbon signatures detected by SHERLOC Raman and deep-UV fluorescence spectrometer, concentrated in clay and sulfate veins.
Pre-flight cleanroom witness pack exposed to drill head mechanism to baseline terrestrial contaminant thresholds.
Layered sandstone formed in ancient turbulent river mouth bar; shows ripple cross-lamination.
Carbonate-bearing siltstone; carbonates form in neutral-to-alkaline waters with abundant CO2, making it an exceptional medium for fossilizing microbial signatures.
